title: Impact of Vietnam Service on Long-Term Earnings

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy  
Method: Instrumental‐Variables (2SLS) with the draft‐lottery number (z) as an instrument for Vietnam service (x).  
Key assumptions  
1. Relevance: Low lottery numbers increased the probability of being drafted (Cov(z,x) ≠ 0).  
2. Exclusion: Lottery number affects later earnings (y) only through military service, not directly or through omitted channels.  
3. Independence: Lottery numbers were randomly assigned, making z independent of potential outcomes and unobserved earnings determinants, conditional on controls (age, education).  
4. Monotonicity: No individual serves less because they receive a lower (more draft-eligible) lottery number.  

Under these assumptions, the 2SLS coefficient on x identifies the causal effect of Vietnam service on long-term log earnings.

## 2. R Code
```r
# ---- libraries ----
if (!requireNamespace("AER", quietly = TRUE))  install.packages("AER")
if (!requireNamespace("ivreg", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("ivreg")
if (!requireNamespace("sandwich", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("sandwich")
if (!requireNamespace("lmtest",  quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("lmtest")

library(AER)       # contains ivreg()
library(ivreg)     # robust iv tools
library(sandwich)  # robust vcov
library(lmtest)    # coeftest

# ---- read data ----
path <- "experiments/exp_b/data/s69_data.csv"
df   <- read.csv(path)

# ---- identify control variables automatically ----
controls <- setdiff(names(df), c("y", "x", "z"))
ctrl_rhs <- if (length(controls) > 0) paste(controls, collapse = " + ") else "1"

# ---- formulas ----
form_ols <- as.formula(paste("y ~ x +", ctrl_rhs))
form_iv  <- as.formula(paste("y ~ x +", ctrl_rhs, " | z +", ctrl_rhs))

# ---- OLS benchmark ----
ols <- lm(form_ols, data = df)
cat("\nOLS estimate of service on log earnings:\n")
print(coeftest(ols, vcov = vcovHC(ols, type = "HC1"))["x", ])

# ---- IV (2SLS) estimate ----
iv  <- ivreg(form_iv, data = df)
robust_se <- sqrt(diag(vcovHC(iv, type = "HC1")))
cat("\nIV (2SLS) estimate of service on log earnings:\n")
print(cbind(Estimate = coef(iv)["x"], `Robust SE` = robust_se["x"],
            `t value` = coef(iv)["x"]/robust_se["x"]))

# ---- Weak‐instrument diagnostic ----
fs <- lm(as.formula(paste("x ~ z +", ctrl_rhs)), data = df)
fs_F <- waldtest(fs, . ~ . - z)$F[2]  # first‐stage F-stat on z
cat("\nFirst-stage F statistic on instrument z:", round(fs_F, 2), "\n")

# ---- Anderson–Rubin CI (robust to weak IV) ----
ar_ci <- function(ivobj, parm = "x", level = 0.95){
  confint(ivobj, parm = parm, level = level, vcov = vcovHC(ivobj, type = "HC1"), method = "AR")
}
cat("\nAnderson–Rubin 95% CI for the causal effect:\n")
print(ar_ci(iv, "x"))

# ---- Placebo robustness: instrument on controls (should be nil) ----
if ("age" %in% controls){
  placebo <- ivreg(as.formula("age ~ x | z"), data = df)
  cat("\nPlacebo test – IV effect of service on age (should be 0):\n")
  print(coeftest(placebo, vcov = vcovHC(placebo, type = "HC1"))["x", ])
}

# ---- Output key numeric result for replication ----
cat("\nKEY RESULT — 2SLS point estimate on Vietnam service:", round(coef(iv)["x"], 4),
    "with robust SE:", round(robust_se["x"], 4), "\n")
```

## 3. Expected Findings  
Sign: Negative. Military service during Vietnam likely lowered long-term civilian earnings because of foregone labor-market experience, possible physical/psychological costs, and delayed education.  

Magnitude: A decline of roughly −0.10 to −0.20 in log earnings (≈9–18 % lower earnings) is expected, consistent with previous veteran wage-penalty estimates once selection is purged via the lottery instrument.

_ground_truth.identification_strategy: Use draft lottery number as an instrument for Vietnam service.
_ground_truth.conclusion_detail: Military service during the Vietnam War positively affects long-term earnings.
